title: Reading Practice Test 13 – Health & Wellness
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: phiếu hẹn khám, quảng cáo phòng tập, bài báo có chèn câu, đoạn kép). Chủ đề: phòng khám, bảo hiểm, sức khoẻ nơi làm việc.

questions.content: The clinic has extended its hours to better serve patients ------- work during the day.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ thay cho người ('patients'), làm chủ ngữ của 'work' → 'who'.

questions.content: Regular exercise can ------- reduce the risk of heart disease.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ đứng giữa 'can' và động từ 'reduce' để bổ nghĩa → 'significantly'.

questions.content: Patients are asked to arrive fifteen minutes ------- their scheduled appointment.
questions.explanation: 'before + danh từ' = trước. 'prior' cần 'to', 'ahead' cần 'of'.

questions.content: The new fitness center will offer yoga classes ------- evening from 6:00 to 7:00 P.M.
questions.explanation: 'every + danh từ số ít' (evening) = mỗi tối. 'all/many/few' đi với danh từ số nhiều.

questions.content: Dr. Harris is ------- regarded as one of the best surgeons in the region.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho phân từ 'regarded' → 'widely regarded' (được đánh giá rộng rãi).

questions.content: The health insurance plan covers most medical expenses, ------- dental care is not included.
questions.explanation: Hai vế tương phản (chi trả hầu hết – nhưng không gồm nha khoa) → 'but'.

questions.content: Employees who participate in the wellness program ------- a discount on gym memberships.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ chính 'Employees' số nhiều (mệnh đề 'who…' chỉ bổ nghĩa) → 'receive'.

questions.content: The pharmacy will be closed on Monday ------- the national holiday.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ 'the national holiday' và chỉ nguyên nhân → 'owing to'.

questions.content: It is important to drink plenty of water, ------- during hot weather.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ nhấn mạnh cho cụm giới từ 'during hot weather' → 'especially' (đặc biệt là).

questions.content: The hospital ------- a new wing for children next year.
questions.explanation: 'next year' → tương lai 'will open'.

groups.passage:
Staff Wellness Update

We are happy to report that more than 200 employees ---131--- in last month's Step Challenge. Together, participants walked over 30 million steps!

Because the challenge was so popular, we will hold it again in the fall. ---132---. Prizes will include gift cards and extra vacation days.

In addition, starting next month, healthy snacks such as fruit and nuts will be ---133--- in all break rooms at no cost to employees.

---134--- you have ideas for future wellness activities, please share them with the Human Resources team.

questions.explanation: 'last month' → quá khứ đơn 'participated'.

options.A: This time, teams of five will compete against each other.
options.B: Our cafeteria menu will change soon.
options.D: The office will be painted in October.

questions.explanation: Câu trước nói thử thách sẽ tổ chức lại vào mùa thu, câu sau nói giải thưởng → câu chèn mô tả thể lệ lần này (thi theo đội).
Sau 'will be' cần tính từ → 'available' (có sẵn).
Điều kiện 'Nếu bạn có ý tưởng…' → 'If'.

groups.passage:
APPOINTMENT REMINDER
Bright Smile Dental Clinic

Patient: Kevin Zhang
Date: Tuesday, April 22 · Time: 3:30 P.M.
Dentist: Dr. Olivia Grant
Service: Routine cleaning and checkup

Please bring your insurance card. If you need to cancel or reschedule, call us at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a $30 fee.

questions.content: What is the purpose of the card?

options.A: To remind a patient of an upcoming visit
options.B: To advertise a new dental service
options.C: To request payment for a treatment

questions.explanation: 'APPOINTMENT REMINDER' – nhắc lịch hẹn sắp tới.

questions.content: What will most likely happen if Mr. Zhang cancels on the day of his appointment?

options.A: He must pay for the cleaning.
options.C: He will have to pay a fee.
options.D: He will not be able to book again.

questions.explanation: Huỷ trong ngày = chưa báo trước 24 giờ → bị tính phí $30.

groups.passage:
Summit Fitness – Grand Opening!
Our newest location opens on Saturday, June 1, at 250 Harbor Road.

What we offer:
• State-of-the-art cardio and weight machines
• Over 40 group classes each week, including spinning, Pilates, and boxing
• An indoor swimming pool and sauna
• Free parking for members

Opening special: Join before June 15 and pay no registration fee (normally $50). Members who sign up for a 12-month plan will also receive two free sessions with a personal trainer.

Open Monday–Friday, 5:00 A.M.–11:00 P.M.; Saturday–Sunday, 7:00 A.M.–9:00 P.M.

questions.content: What is being advertised?
questions.explanation: 'Our newest location opens on Saturday, June 1' – chi nhánh phòng tập mới.

questions.content: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of Summit Fitness?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi NOT: quảng cáo không nhắc tới quán cà phê.

questions.content: What will people who sign up for a one-year plan receive?
questions.explanation: 'Members who sign up for a 12-month plan will also receive two free sessions with a personal trainer.'

groups.passage:
Sitting Less at Work

Office workers spend an average of nine hours a day sitting, according to a study published in the Journal of Occupational Health. [1] Researchers found that long periods of sitting are linked to back pain, poor circulation, and reduced energy.

The good news is that small changes can make a big difference. The study recommends standing up and moving around for at least five minutes every hour. [2] Some companies have also installed adjustable desks that allow employees to work while standing.

At Norland Insurance, for example, 80 percent of employees now use standing desks for part of the day. [3] "People tell us they feel more alert in the afternoon," said human resources director Paula Grant. The company also encourages "walking meetings," in which small groups discuss projects while walking outdoors. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.D: Reducing the time employees spend seated

questions.explanation: Bài viết về tác hại của ngồi lâu và cách giảm thời gian ngồi ở nơi làm việc.

questions.content: What does the study recommend?

options.A: Moving around for a few minutes every hour
options.B: Working from home twice a week

questions.explanation: '…standing up and moving around for at least five minutes every hour.'

questions.content: The word "linked" in paragraph 1, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'are linked to back pain' = có liên quan tới đau lưng → connected.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Setting a reminder on a phone or computer can help workers remember to take these breaks."
questions.explanation: 'these breaks' chỉ việc đứng dậy vận động mỗi giờ được nhắc ngay trước đó → vị trí [2].

groups.passage:
Riverside Family Clinic – New Patient Information

Office hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 A.M.–6:00 P.M.; Saturday, 9:00 A.M.–12:00 P.M.

• New patients should complete the registration form online at least two days before their first visit.
• Please bring a photo ID and your insurance card to every appointment.
• Same-day appointments are available for urgent health problems. Call before 10:00 A.M.
• Our clinic accepts most major insurance plans, including HealthFirst, CareOne, and MediPlus. Patients with other insurance should contact our billing office before their visit.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: info@riversidefamilyclinic.com
From: Sandra Obi
Date: October 6
Subject: First appointment

Hello,

I recently moved to Riverside and would like to become a patient at your clinic. I have booked my first appointment with Dr. Chen for this Saturday at 10:00 A.M., and I completed the registration form this morning.

My insurance is provided by Unity Health through my new employer. I did not see Unity Health listed on your Web site, so I would like to know whether your clinic accepts it.

Also, I work on weekdays until 6:00 P.M. Is Dr. Chen available for Saturday appointments in the future?

Thank you,
Sandra Obi

questions.content: What is indicated about same-day appointments?

options.A: They are for urgent health problems.
options.B: They are available only on Saturdays.

questions.explanation: 'Same-day appointments are available for urgent health problems.'

questions.content: What does Ms. Obi say she has already done?
questions.explanation: 'I completed the registration form this morning' → đã điền giấy tờ đăng ký.

questions.content: Whom should Ms. Obi most likely contact about her insurance?
questions.explanation: Unity Health không có trong danh sách; theo thông tin phòng khám, bệnh nhân dùng bảo hiểm khác nên liên hệ phòng thanh toán (billing office).

questions.content: What is true about Ms. Obi's first appointment?

options.A: It is on a weekday evening.
options.B: It was booked by her employer.
options.D: It falls within the clinic's Saturday hours.

questions.explanation: Hẹn thứ Bảy lúc 10:00, nằm trong giờ làm việc thứ Bảy (9:00–12:00).

questions.content: Why does Ms. Obi ask about Saturday appointments?

options.A: She works until the clinic closes on weekdays.
options.B: She prefers to see a different doctor.
options.D: Her insurance covers only weekend visits.

questions.explanation: Cô làm tới 6 giờ chiều các ngày thường – đúng giờ phòng khám đóng cửa – nên chỉ khám được thứ Bảy.
